newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares turn tail to close higher.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares turn tail to close higher.

text.p: Delhi shares reversed trend to close higher on Friday as foreign institutional investors (FIIS) stepped up purchases amid some short-covering, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index ended 4.54 points higher at 709.39 after touching the day's low of 702.78. It was 0.89 point down in early trade.
"Fresh spell of buying by FIIs in heavy-weighted stocks after the long Christmas and winter break also had a positive impact," said Ashok Arya of brokers S.C. Gupta.
Reliance Industries quoted 3.20 rupees higher at 217.20.
State Bank of India firmed 4.45 rupees to 245.45.
Larsen and Toubro rose 3.75 rupees to 232.
